टीटू मामा की वापसी का हुआ ऐलान, मचाएंगे अब नेटफ्लिक्स पर कोहराम! 🎬

सबके पसंदीदा क्रिएटर भुवन बाम अपने मशहूर शो Dhindora के दूसरे सीजन के साथ वापस आ रहे हैं।
यह शो सीधे 20 नवंबर को Netflix पर रिलीज होगा।

कहानी में टीटू मामा पर 11 करोड़ रुपये का नुकसान झेलने का संकट है और वो अपने ससुराल वालों के साथ सुलह करने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं।
रोहित राज और भुवन बाम ने मिलकर इस नए सीजन को प्रोड्यूस किया है।

भुवन का कहना है कि यह सीजन पहले से बड़े कैनवस पर होगा लेकिन इसमें वही पुराना देसीपन और कॉमेडी बरकरार रहेगी।

क्या आप टीटू मामा के नए कारनामों को देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? कमेंट में बताओ! 🍿🔥

ctx.summary:
Dhindora Season 2 returns with Bhuvan Bam’s Titu Mama facing an ₹11 crore loss and fresh trouble with his in-laws on Netflix. 
 The post  Dhindora Season 2 Release Date: Bhuvan Bam’s Titu Mama Returns With More Trouble On Netlfix  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
YouTube creator-actor Bhuvan Bam brings the iconic BB Ki Vines universe back on Netflix with season 2 of his first full-fledged web series, Dhindora . Season 2 is returning with a comedy-drama packed with laugh-out-loud moments, outrageous situations, and non-stop entertainment.
Titu Mama is back, and trouble seems to be waiting for him at every turn, with him facing an ₹11 crore loss and trying to make peace with his in-laws. But as fans of the character know, even a simple family matter can quickly turn into a full-blown drama.
The new season brings back the familiar characters and humor from BB Ki Vines, with Titu Mama at the center of another chaotic family adventure. The season continues to follow the characters and comedy that made Dhindora a fan favorite while putting Titu Mama’s latest troubles at the heart of the story.
Bhuvan Bam is extending the popular Dhindora series with a second season. The wait is no longer, as Dhindora Season 2 will premiere on Netflix on November 20. The new season is produced by Rohit Raj and Bhuvan Bam.
The first season of Dhindora was released on Bam’s YouTube channel and quickly gained traction. Built around everyday family chaos, small-town ambitions, and flawed decisions, the series connected strongly with online audiences.
Creator of Dhindora and BB Ki Vines, Bhuvan Bam said, “Dhindora began on as a chaotic and deeply relatable world, and Season 2 takes that heart and humor to a much bigger canvas. Bringing it to Netflix lets us share these characters with a wider audience without losing the cultural specificity that made the show feel like home. I’m so excited for long-time fans and new viewers to dive into this next chapter.”
Season 1 marked a major step in Bhuvan Bam’s journey from creating internet characters to building a long-form fictional universe. The new season continues that story, bringing Titu Mama and the BB Ki Vines characters to a wider audience. Dhindora Season 2 premieres November 20, only on Netflix
